tei:div.tei:p: na mo mañdzu shṝ ye/ rnal 'byor rgyud kyi gsol 'debs rdo rje theg pa'i sgo 'byed ces bya ba/ rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rigs kyi gtso bo rgyal ba snang rnam mdzad/ /rigs kyi 'khor los bsgyur rgyal gsang ba'i bdag/rigs kyi sras mchog rab gsal zla ba'i zhabs/ /rigs kyi dpal mgon gsum la gsol ba 'debs/ /sgra gcan 'dzin zhabs ye shes rdo rje dang*// shes rab dngos grub nyi ma'i snying po ste/ /rgyal po'i thugs sras kun snying bla ma'i mchog |rigs 'dzin gtso bo rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /tshig dang rigs pa la mkhas shākya bshes/ /don dang man ngag la mkhas sangs rgyas gsang*// gnyis ka lag len la mkhas kun snying zhabs/ /yo ga'i mkhas mchog gsum la gsol ba 'debs/ /de dag dang mnyam 'jam dpal grags pa dang*// 'jam dpal bshes gnyen sgeg pa'i rdo rje dang*/ /a ba dhu ti dzñā na shī la sogs| |yo ga'i bstan 'dzin rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /kun snyingasheb rab bskyangs dang rab 'byor bskyangs// sher byang grol mdzad dharma pā la'i zhabs| |sprul pa'i skyes mchog lo chen bka' drin can/ /rin chen bzang po'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /lo chung la sogs stod kyi bu chen bzhi/ /chos blo la sogs dbu gtsang mkhas pa gsum/ /gzhan yang zangs dkar gnyan ston tsar+ya sogs/ /bod yul mkhas grub rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ khyad par dbang rgyud gur shing brtson grus rgyal/ /gnyal nyi snur nyi dkon grags rgya gar 'phan| |shag 'bum sangs 'bum chos sku 'phags 'od bu/ /lo mchog dpal ldan zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /mdo sngags spyi dang khyad par rnal 'byor rgyud| |ches cher nyams pa legs par gsos nas ni/ /rgya cher rgyas mdzad bod kyi mig gcig po/ /bu ston chos rje'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /bla ma dam pa lo chen sems dpa' che/ /yang na byang rtse grags rgyal 'jigs med grags| |rnal 'byor rgyud kyi bka' drin stsaul mdzad pa'i/

/rtsa rgyud mtshungs med rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /gzhan yang*/ rdo rje 'chang dbang 'jam dbyangs ye shes zhabs/ /'jam dpal grags pa dpal sde dri med sbas/ /rin chen rdo rje sher 'byung sbas pa'i zhabs/ /bzhad pa'i rdo rje shrad dha ka ra dang*/ /lo chen lo chung dge sar dar ma grags/ khri ston chos rin chos sku 'phags pa 'od// bu ston rin rnam kun dge 'phel ba mkhyen sems dpa'anam 'od pa che/ /gsung dbang bla ma'i tshogs la gsol ba 'debs/ /sangs rgyas 'jam dbyangs sgeg rdaur mu dra'i sid+dhizhabs/ pūr ṇa sing ha lha dbang smṛ ti ngag gi dbang*/ /rdo rje rtog shes rab chos rdor rgya 'a ma can shaka kya seng ge khri ston sogs/ /gsang ldan bla ma'i tshogs la gsol ba 'debs/ /sangs rgyas phyag rdor rab gsal sgra gcan 'dzin/ /kun snying de bzhin gshegs rdor shrad dha dkar/ /lo chen lo chung ye 'bar tshul khrims 'bar/ /thod pa dben tsha grags dang ye shes 'od/ /rong pa chos mgon 'phags pa rin po che/ /bkra shis dpal dang lo mchog dpal ldan bu/ /rin rnam grags rgyal dpal ldan 'jigs med grags/ /kun rig bla ma'i tshogs la gsol ba 'debs/ /rdo rje theg pa'i chu gter chen po'i byings// sngags lam dpag bsam yongs 'du'i rtsa ba mchog /rgya bod mkhas grub kun gyi longs spyod che/ /rnal 'byor rgyud kun spel bar byin gyis rlobs/ /bya spyod la med 'khyud pa'i bde stong mchog /dbang du ngo sprod lam gyi gtsor byas nas// mngon byang lnga yis myur du 'tshang rgya'i tshul/ /legs par rtogs nas bde blag 'grub par shog /bdag rdzogs rnal 'byor chen po ting 'dzin gsum// rang don bsnyen pa'i yan lag mthar phyin nas/ /sbyor dngos mjug gsum skyon med cho ga yis/ /gzhan don dkyil 'khor las rim 'grub bar shog/ ces dang*/ spro na/ khrus byas lce lag byin rlabs bsrung 'khor bsgom/ /tshogs bsags sngags sdom bzung nas gzugs brnyan sbyor/

/ngan 'gro dgug cing dral nas tshogs rten bsdu/ /spyi dgos sngaun 'gro'i yan lag rdzogs par shog/gzhi lus lhar bskyed snying gar bdag 'jug blang*/ /sems dpa' lus bsgrub sgrub chen phyag rgya bzhi/ /byin rlabs dbang bskur mchod pa gsum rdzogs pas/ /bdag rdzogs rnal 'byor chen po mthar phyin shog/zhing sbyang rten skye snyoms 'jug mdun dmigs dran/ /mi g.yo mthar son mngon byang chen po lngas/ /rdzogs par byang chub byin rlabs dbang bskur gshegs/ /dang po sbyor ba'i ting 'dzin mthar phyin shog /dbyings phyug sngags dang phyag rgyas byin gyis brlabs/ /ting 'dzin drag sngags gyis bskul sprau zhing bsdus/ /don byas lhar gyur ched brjod gnas la 'khod/ /dgyes gyur dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog mngon 'gyur shog/kun bsdus snying gar bcugs cing slar yang phyung*/ /so sor thim zhing dgug gzhug dbang bskur mchog /rgyas gdab phrin las mchog la bskul ba sogs/ /las kyi rgyal mchog ting 'dzin mthar phyin shog/de ltar rnal 'byor rtsa ba rdo rje'i dbyings| |thabs shes bshad rgyud cha mthun dang bcas lam/ /de bzhin gshegs dang rdo rje pad ma las/ /rigs bzhi'i dkyil 'khor mtha' dag mngon 'gyur shog/phyag chen dam tshig chos dang las kyi rgya/ /snying po phyag rgya gsang sngags rigs sngags lam/ /rtsa gzungs chos las dkyil 'khor bzhi la sogs| |sprul bshad mtha' dag nyams len rdzogs par shog /rjes su rnal 'byor shin tu rnal 'byor dang*/ /rnal 'byor cher gyur yo ga'i rgyud kun rdzogs// bla med pha ma gnyis med rgyud gsum la/ /bde blag zhugs nas dngos grub cher rgyas shog /ces rnal 'byor rgyud kyi ston pa dang bstan 'dzin la gsol ba 'debs cing*/ bstan pa mtha' dag smon lam du byas pa 'di yang*/ mdo sngags mtha' dag rgyas par 'dod pa'i lo tsā ba sher rab rin chen gyis sbyar ba dge legs 'phel bar gyur cig

kun rig pas dgos su byed na/ rgyas pa'i lo chen gyi rjes su/ go pi sgom chen kyi nor dzñā na dang*/ /gnyal nyid sogs sbyar/ bla ma dam pa lo chen sems dpa' che'i tshab tu/ byang seng rgyal bzang rtag pa chos rdor sogs| |zhes pa bcug gsung dbang sogs bzhag rdo rje theg pa'i chu gter sogs tshigs bcad gsum gyi mjug tu/ dga' ba'i tshal du rgyal bas rgyud gsung tshe/ /nor bu dri med mnar med nas drangs ltar/ /rnam dag cho ga 'dis kyang dmigs pa'i yul/ /'khor ba las grol rnam snang myur thob shog /ces pas kyang 'grub bo/ /bsdu na/ kun rig dgos kyi brgyud pa la/ rin chen rnam rgyal rin chen rgyal mtshan zhabs/ /zhes sogs rang rang gi bla ma bcug pas 'grub bo// //dge'o// // mes po'i shul bzhag las/ stag tshang lo tsā ba shes rab rin chen gyi bka' 'bum/rnal 'byor rgyud kyi gsol 'debs/ -PAGE 176--PAGE 177-- PAGE 175-
